precondition.description: A customer supplies exact manuscript bytes, a deterministic standards reading, source and claim evidence, production provenance, and policy digests without filesystem authority.

move.description: The provider contracts LISS for Sonnet inference under one provider-validated output schema. Sonnet writes a prose assessment and selects exactly one of submit_editorial_acceptance, submit_revision_request, or submit_editorial_refusal. The provider returns that selection and its complete upstream result without invoking the customer's tool.

postcondition.description: The customer receives one schema-validated tool selection bound to the exact manuscript and editorial context, plus prose grounds and provider receipts. Only customer-owned deterministic code may invoke the selected tool and create an editorial judgment.

constraints: the provider never reads or writes customer territory
free-form prose labels confer no publication authority
only submit_editorial_acceptance can nominate publication and customer law may still refuse it
all structured arguments are provider-validated as a bounded tool selection
provider or resource failure returns obstruction without silent resolicitation
